semantic_classes.description: Goal-shaped reward rendered pale green (RGB ~189,224,138): GoodGoal, GoodGoalBounce. Verified pixel-identical across instances — a single frame cannot tell the two apart; see evaluation's per-exact-class recall to check individual coverage.
semantic_classes.name: GoodGoal

semantic_classes.description: Goal-shaped object rendered in the same yellow (RGB ~245,221,104) as GoodGoalMulti, GoodGoalMultiBounce, GrowGoal, and ShrinkGoal. Verified pixel-identical across instances in this checkout — visual discrimination between them is not possible from appearance alone in a single frame.
semantic_classes.name: GoodGoalMulti

semantic_classes.description: Generic movable block: LBlock, JBlock, UBlock. All three are frequently mistaken for Wall at oblique angles; HeavyBlock, HollowBox and LightBlock are kept as their own classes rather than folded in here.
semantic_classes.name: jul_blocks

semantic_classes.description: A goal that provides positive reward and decays in value over the episode.
semantic_classes.name: DecayGoal

semantic_classes.description: A DecayGoal variant that also ends the episode on collection.
semantic_classes.name: DecayGoalEpEnding

semantic_classes.description: A goal that provides positive reward and ripens in value over the episode.
semantic_classes.name: RipenGoal

semantic_classes.description: A RipenGoal variant that also ends the episode on collection.
semantic_classes.name: RipenGoalEpEnding

semantic_classes.description: Goal-shaped object that provides negative reward, rendered red (RGB ~244,109,112): BadGoal, BadGoalBounce. Verified pixel-identical across instances — a single frame cannot tell the two apart. BadGoalMulti is a distinct flat orange and is kept as its own class rather than folded in here.
semantic_classes.name: BadGoal

semantic_classes.description: A BadGoal that splits reward across every BadGoalMulti instance in the arena. Rendered a distinct flat orange (RGB ~255,117,0), not the red of the merged BadGoal class, so kept as its own class.
semantic_classes.name: BadGoalMulti

semantic_classes.description: Goal-shaped distractor with no reward, rendered light grey (RGB ~212,220,228): DecoyGoal, DecoyGoalBounce, DecoyGoalMulti. Verified pixel-identical across instances — visual discrimination between them is not possible from appearance alone in a single frame.
semantic_classes.name: DecoyGoal
